# confounder control: null model - how many random source/target pairs in window achieve delta-600 cascade?
import random, collections
random.seed(0)
sub=[e for e in events if 46296<=e[2]<=48695]
nodes=sorted({x for e in sub for x in e[:2]})
def cascade(s,tg):
    best={s:None}
    for u,v,t in sub:
        if u in best and (best[u] is None or best[u]<=t<=best[u]+600):
            if v not in best or (best[v] is not None and t<best[v]): best[v]=t
    return tg in best, len(best)
hits=0; sizes=[]
for _ in range(300):
    s,tg=random.sample(nodes,2)
    h,sz=cascade(s,tg); hits+=h; sizes.append(sz)
print("random pair cascade success rate:", hits/300, "median reach size:", sorted(sizes)[150])
# shuffled-time control: permute timestamps within window, retest 303->1293
orig=[(u,v) for u,v,t in sub]; ts=[t for _,_,t in sub]
succ=0
for _ in range(200):
    random.shuffle(ts)
    ev=sorted([(u,v,t) for (u,v),t in zip(orig,ts)], key=lambda e:e[2])
    best={303:None}
    for u,v,t in ev:
        if u in best and (best[u] is None or best[u]<=t<=best[u]+600):
            if v not in best or (best[v] is not None and t<best[v]): best[v]=t
    succ+= (1293 in best)
print("time-shuffled success rate:", succ/200)
